article_title: Israel deploys thousands of troops, drones in attack on Jenin stronghold in terrorism 'hotspot'
sentence: Jenin has been a hotbed of Palestinian terrorist activity for months, with Iranian-backed militants carrying out attacks within Israel.
target_entity: Palestinian armed groups operating in Jenin

article_title: Israel completes withdrawal from Jenin amid exchange of rockets, airstrikes
sentence: Jenin has been a hotbed of Palestinian terrorist activity for months, with Iranian-backed militants using it as a base to carry out attacks within Israel.
target_entity: Palestinian armed groups operating in Jenin
explanation: Narrator uses a threat-intensifying characterization; this does not establish a view of Palestinian civilians.

article_title: Anti-Israel agitators light flares outside Columbia University 'occupation'
sentence: House Republicans also grilled Columbia leadership over tenured professor, Joseph Massad, who celebrated the Oct. 7 attacks and Hamas' slaughter of nearly 1,200 Jews as "awesome," "astonishing," "astounding" and "incredible."
explanation: Emotionally loaded narrator wording about Hamas; factual deaths and quoted praise are not themselves author opinions.

article_title: Israeli raid on West Bank refugee camp cut water access for thousands, left 173 homeless, U.N. says
sentence: Tension has risen steadily since Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu returned to power last year, bringing with him Israel's most far-right government ever.
explanation: Narrator supplies a comparative political characterization. It is analytical framing, not proof of personal hostility; whether this qualifies as opinion is a boundary case.

article_title: Dozens killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza overnight amid fears of widening conflict
sentence: American and other international efforts pushing Israel to do more to alleviate the suffering of Palestinian civilians have met with little success.
target_entity: Israeli response to international humanitarian pressure
explanation: Narrator makes an assessment of the effectiveness of pressure on Israel. This is an analytical assessment, not an explicit statement of support or opposition.

article_title: Pro-Palestinian protests leave American college campuses on edge
sentence: The demonstrations have ramped up in recent days as Israel's devastating war against Hamas grinds on in the Gaza Strip, where the Hamas-run Health Ministry says more than 34,000 people have been killed, most of them women and children.
explanation: The narrator uses evaluative wording for the Israeli campaign. Mention of Hamas does not itself evaluate Hamas, so this sentence is not labeled both.
